mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! I’m really glad you’re here. You know, in the whirlwind of everyday life, it’s easy for the most important connections—our families—to get lost in the shuffle. What if we could create a home that feels like a safe harbor, even when the world outside gets a little stormy? That’s what we’re about to explore together, inspired by Stephen R. Covey’s heartfelt book, The 7 Habits of Highly Effective Families: Creating a Nurturing Family in a Turbulent World. This isn’t about chasing some unrealistic version of perfection. Instead, it’s about finding simple, intentional steps that help us grow, connect, and support each other—no matter what life throws our way. Covey’s timeless principles give us real tools for building trust, deepening unity, and turning everyday moments into opportunities for resilience and joy. As we go along, you’ll see how things like empathy, open communication, and shared values can spark change—helping families not just weather tough times, but truly thrive together. So, are you ready to discover what’s possible when we choose to grow as a family? Let’s start this journey side by side, and see how each of us can help create a home where everyone feels seen, heard, and inspired to be their very best.
